app.name: MoodVerse
app.description: Share what is on your heart and receive one passage from the Holy Bible or the Holy Quran, drawn from verified text and chosen with care.

auth.title: Keep your reflections <accent>safe</accent>
auth.body: Sign in to save passages and keep a private history on every device.
auth.guestNote: Guest reflections stay in this browser. By continuing you agree to our <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue.

errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.unreachable: We can’t reach MoodVerse right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.wrongPassword: That email and password don’t match.
errors.exists: There’s already an account with this email. Sign in instead, or use a sign-in link.
errors.link: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one below.
errors.google: We couldn’t finish signing you in with Google. Please try again.

reflect.title: How are you feeling <accent>right now?</accent>
reflect.tooShort: Could you say a little more? A sentence or two about what’s on your mind helps us choose well.

offline.title: You’re offline
offline.body: Your words are saved in this browser. We’ll find a passage as soon as you’re back online.

reflect.voiceUnavailable: Voice isn’t available in this browser.
reflect.voiceNote: Voice preview. Audio isn’t kept; only the text you approve.
reflect.submitHint: Press Ctrl+Enter, or ⌘+Enter on a Mac, to find a passage.

motion.label: Gentle motion
motion.body: Slow image drift and breathing animations.

meta.title: MoodVerse · Your emotions meet scripture
meta.ogAlt: A dawn lake under a soft sky, with the words: Your emotions meet scripture.

hero.body: Share what is on your heart and receive one passage from the Holy Bible or the Holy Quran, drawn from verified text and chosen with care.
hero.mockupWhy: You described loneliness and doubt after a big change. This psalm speaks to God’s nearness in exactly those moments.

feel.title: Meets what you feel
feel.body: Not just the words you type, but the need underneath them.

verified.title: Verified scripture
verified.body: Exact text with its reference and translation. Never AI-written.

traditions.title: Two traditions
traditions.body: The Holy Bible or the Holy Quran, each with equal care.

return.title: A space to return to
return.body: Save the words that stay with you, privately.

reflect.title: Reflect
reflect.body: Write how you feel in your own words, as much or as little as you like.

understand.title: Understand
understand.body: MoodVerse notices the emotions and the need beneath what you wrote.

receive.title: Receive
receive.body: One verified passage, its exact reference, and a sentence on why it was chosen.

how.snippet: I moved to a new city for work and I feel so alone…

traditions.title: Each on its own terms, with the same care.
traditions.body: Choose the Holy Bible or the Holy Quran for any reflection. Passages are never blended, paraphrased or mixed in the app.

trust.title: Scripture handled with care. Your words kept safe.

verified.title: Verified sources
verified.body: Every passage comes from published editions stored as exact text, always shown with its reference and translation.

never.title: Never AI-written verses
never.body: Technology helps choose which passage to show. It never writes, edits or paraphrases scripture.

private.title: Private reflections
private.body: What you write is private by default and never appears on a share card. Export or delete it anytime.

gallery.title: Share a passage, not your private thoughts.
gallery.body: Twelve backgrounds sized for stories, including your own photo or a transparent PNG you can place anywhere. Your reflection is never added.

chatbot.title: Not a chatbot
chatbot.body: No conversation, no persona. You write; you receive one passage.

therapy.title: Not therapy
therapy.body: It can sit beside care, never replace it. If you’re in crisis, please contact local emergency services or a crisis line.

authority.title: Not a theological authority
authority.body: Each note explains our choice, not the passage’s meaning. For guidance, turn to your community and teachers.

ai.a: No. Every passage is exact text from a published edition, shown with its reference and translation. Technology only helps decide which passage to offer.

who.a: Only you. Reflections are private by default, never added to share cards, and you can export or delete them in Settings.

background.q: Can I use my own background on a share card?
background.a: Yes. Choose one of your photos, or save the card as a transparent PNG and place it on any background you like.

account.q: Can I use it without an account?
account.a: Yes. Continue as a guest and your reflections stay on that device. Sign in later to keep them across devices.

serious.q: What if I’m going through something serious?
serious.a: MoodVerse still offers a passage, alongside a gentle note encouraging you to reach out to someone you trust or a local support line.

cta.title: Take a quiet moment.
cta.body: On iPhone, Android and the web.

welcome.caption: Come as you are. Leave with a little light.

step1.title: A quiet place to bring <accent>how you feel.</accent>
step1.body: Write a few honest words. Receive one passage of scripture that meets you there, with a short note on why it was chosen.

step2.title: What MoodVerse is, and what it isn’t

scripture.title: Scripture, never invented
scripture.body: Verified text with its exact reference and translation.

chatbot.title: Not a chatbot
chatbot.body: No conversation to keep up. Just your words and one passage.

therapy.title: Not therapy or an authority
therapy.body: A pause, alongside the people and guidance you trust.

private.title: Private by default
private.body: Nothing is shared unless you choose to share it.

step3.title: Where would you like to begin?
step3.body: You can switch for any reflection, or change this later in Settings.
step3.label: Default tradition
step3.bible: King James Version · more in Settings
